# metalite

Unified representation of metadata structure for clinical analysis &
reporting (A&R) by leveraging the Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets.

![](reference/figures/design-diagram.png)

## Installation

The easiest way to get metalite is to install from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("metalite")
```

Alternatively, to use a new feature or get a bug fix, you can install
the development version of metalite from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Merck/metalite")
```

## Overview

The metalite framework is designed to:

- Standardize function input for analysis and reporting.
- Separate analysis logic from data source.
- Enable the use of pipes (`|>`).
- Reduce manual steps to develop and maintain documentation in clinical
  trial development.
- Ensure consistency between analysis specification, mock, and results.

## Use cases

The metalite package offers a foundation to simplify tool development
and create standard engineering workflows. For example, metalite can be
used to:

- Standardize input and output for A&R functions.
- Create analysis and reporting planning grid.
- Create mock table.
- Create and validate A&R results.
- Trace analysis records.

Note: metalite is a low-level R package that needs to work with other R
packages to complete the work. The idea is illustrated in the diagram
above.

## Design principles

We built metalite with the following principles:

- Automation: prefer a function call more than a checklist.
- Single-entry: enter in one place, sync to all deliveries.
  - For example, enter data source one time for all AE analysis.
- End-to-end: cover all steps in software development lifecycle (SDLC)
  from define to delivery.

# Package index

## Create metadata

- [`meta_adam()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_adam.md)
  : Create a metadata representation for ADaM data analysis
- [`meta_inherit()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_inherit.md)
  : Inherit meta information by keywords
- [`meta_split()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_split.md)
  : Split metadata into groups
- [`meta_build()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_build.md)
  : Build complete meta information
- [`meta_run()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_run.md)
  : Execute analysis based on the analysis plan

## Metadata example

- [`meta_example()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_example.md)
  :

  Create an example `meta_adam` object

- [`meta_example_exploration()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_example_exploration.md)
  :

  Create a data exploration `meta_adam` object

## Component definition

- [`define_plan()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/define_plan.md)
  : Define analysis plan meta information for ADaM dataset
- [`define_population()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/define_population.md)
  : Define analysis population meta information for ADaM dataset
- [`define_observation()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/define_observation.md)
  : Define analysis observation meta information for ADaM dataset
- [`define_parameter()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/define_parameter.md)
  : Define analysis parameter meta information for ADaM dataset
- [`define_analysis()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/define_analysis.md)
  : Define analysis function meta information for ADaM dataset

## Collect components

- [`collect_adam_mapping()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_adam_mapping.md)
  :

  Collect `adam_mapping` from `meta_adam` by `name`

- [`collect_population()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_population.md)
  : Collect specification for population definition

- [`collect_population_index()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_population_index.md)
  : Collect population record index from population dataset

- [`collect_population_id()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_population_id.md)
  : Collect subject identifier information from population dataset

- [`collect_population_record()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_population_record.md)
  : Collect population record from population dataset

- [`collect_observation_index()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_observation_index.md)
  : Collect observation record index from observation dataset

- [`collect_observation_record()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_observation_record.md)
  : Collect observation record from observation dataset

- [`collect_dataname()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_dataname.md)
  : Collect specification for dataset name

- [`collect_title()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_title.md)
  : Collect specification for title

- [`collect_n_subject()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/collect_n_subject.md)
  : Collect number of subjects and its subset condition

- [`n_subject()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/n_subject.md)
  : Count number of unique subjects

## Collect specification information

- [`spec_title()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/spec_title.md)
  : Specification for analysis title
- [`spec_filename()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/spec_filename.md)
  : Specification for analysis output filename
- [`spec_call_program()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/spec_call_program.md)
  : Specification for analysis call program
- [`spec_analysis_population()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/spec_analysis_population.md)
  : Specification for population definition

## Construct analysis plan

- [`plan()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/plan.md) :
  Create a analysis plan from all combination of variables
- [`add_plan()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/add_plan.md)
  : Add additional analysis plan

## Variable mapping

- [`adam_mapping()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/adam_mapping.md)
  : Construct ADaM mappings

- [`update_adam_mapping()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/update_adam_mapping.md)
  :

  Update mapping rule in `adam_mapping`

## Outdata

- [`outdata()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/outdata.md) :

  Construct `outdata` class

## Formatting

- [`round_half_away_from_zero()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/round_half_away_from_zero.md)
  : Round half away from zero
- [`format_number()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/format_number.md)
  : Format numbers with fixed decimal places

## Utilities

- [`default_apply()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/default_apply.md)
  : Apply default values to ADaM mappings
- [`meta_add_total()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/meta_add_total.md)
  : Add duplicate data to enable a total group
- [`get_label()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/get_label.md)
  : A function to get the labels of data frame columns
- [`assign_label()`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/assign_label.md)
  : A function to assign labels to a data frame
- [`print(`*`<meta_adam>`*`)`](https://merck.github.io/metalite/reference/print.meta_adam.md)
  : Print a metadata object with its population, observation, and
  analysis plans
